page.overview:
Who is Braius Doomseed?

is a minotaur paladin/bard and a member of Bells Hells. He is played by Sam Riegel.

Braius is a "hot" minotaur. He is a muscular 6 feet 4 inches tall (without the horns), with black fur on his body and pale grey peach fuzz on his face. He has long black hair, a humanoid-appearing face (which becomes more bovine when he gets angry or excited), and two sharp horns. His hands are somewhat hooflike, with three fingers. He has a tail that he uses to scare away bugs. When Bells Hells encountered him within the ruins of Aeor, he wielded a flail with twin balls dripping a black liquid and wore white armor with the horned icon of Asmodeus emblazoned on its chestpiece. One side of his armor also bears the signature of Teven Klask.

After Highbearer Vord spoke with him and decided to let him represent the followers of the Platinum Dragon in the mission against the Ruby Vanguard, Braius removed his original armor to don Truthbearer, a holy relic made of silvered platinum, and he was given a black cape with silver edges to maintain his white, black, and gray aesthetic.

Months after his adventures with Bells Hells he was experimenting with adding some color to his general aesthetic.
